mapper.select: SELECT api_id AS apiId, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(cost_time), 0), 0) AS avgCostTime FROM open_api_log WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY api_id

SELECT app_id AS appId, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(cost_time), 0), 0) AS avgCostTime FROM open_api_log WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY app_id

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail FROM open_api_log WHERE deleted = 0
AND create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time)
